create_method.description: Name of the engine-side function that fills the struct.

version_macro_prefix.description: Prefix of the engine-side version define macros.

exclude_functions.description: Spec functions kept out of the struct, by bare unprefixed name.

api_variable.description: Name of the vtable variable the mapping macros indirect through. Defaults to <prefix>ext_api.

struct_typename.description: Name of the function-pointer struct, as the template declares it. Used by the engine-side header.

version_floor.description: Version whose engine first shipped this struct. Slots cannot predate it, so bands are clamped to it. Defaults to the oldest declared version.
